title: Agent capability-gap sample
scope: Results describe the supplied sample, not model intelligence.

methodology.classification: Each entry receives one primary task category. Nested and flat message formats are normalized. Counts describe entries, not independent incidents.
methodology.frequency_policy: Volume alone is not evidence of strength or weakness. Weakness requires explicit reported friction.

rating_definitions.Critical: At least two relevant entries, with explicit execution blockage in every relevant entry.
rating_definitions.Weak: At least two relevant entries and explicit quality friction, without category-wide blockage.
rating_definitions.Developing: At least two relevant entries and explicit evidence of partial progress or mixed success.
rating_definitions.Covered: At least two relevant entries with concrete task requirements and no reported friction; coverage does not establish successful performance.

limitations: Only user requests and user-reported failures are available; there are no assistant outputs or execution traces.
Absence of reported friction does not prove competence.
Repeated reports may describe the same unresolved incident.

strongest_measured_task_category.basis: Strongest observed task framing: all four relevant requests explicitly require sourcing or verification, with no reported research friction. This choice reflects the nature of the requests, not their volume.
strongest_measured_task_category.demonstrated_performance_strength: Unverified; no successful outcome is present.

categories.evidence: Four requests explicitly require primary or official sources, citations, or verification. No failed research result is reported.
categories.interpretation: Coverage of verification requirements is established; successful research performance is unverified.

categories.evidence: One interface review request; below the two-entry minimum.
No source implementation or code review entries. Command troubleshooting is classified as tool execution.
One of three writing requests explicitly reports an earlier tone mismatch and generic language; the other two do not report friction.
All four relevant entries report blocked execution: two render timeouts, one permission denial, and one server tool error.
categories.interpretation: Critical describes observed task blockage, not its cause. Infrastructure, permissions, and agent behavior cannot be separated from these reports.

surprising_weakness.finding: Routine execution is the clearest observed bottleneck.
surprising_weakness.evidence: Four of four relevant entries explicitly report failures, including two timeouts, a permission denial, and a server tool error.
surprising_weakness.caveat: The evidence establishes operational friction, not whether the model or its environment caused it.

recommendation_status: Relevant skills, not confirmed missing installations.

recommended_skills.purpose: Track long-running work through verified completion.
Improve natural language and voice fidelity.
recommended_skills.evidence: One explicit complaint about generic writing and incorrect tone.
One explicit tone mismatch in correspondence.
